description: Free status lookup for a job accepted by convert_video / probe_media / extract_frames. Requires the job's ownership token - the `t` query parameter of the statusUrl returned at acceptance (store the whole statusUrl; it cannot be regenerated). Status goes [awaiting_upload ->] queued -> finished | error; awaiting_upload jobs report uploadExpiresAt but NEVER the uploadUrl (that credential is handed out exactly once, in the acceptance result); finished jobs carry resultUrl/thumbnailUrl/durationMs (always served by this gateway, never a redirect; free to re-download within 24 hours of completion); a failed charged job (including one that could not be queued after payment) carries retryVoucher. A bad token and an unknown jobId both answer not_found, deliberately.

token.description: Ownership token - the `t` query parameter of statusUrl

name: get_job_status
title: Get job status (free)
